answer: Assignment comes first. Each identity gets a random tenth of the pending transactions to attest, seeded by its own key and the epoch number, and weight counts only those matches. Overlap above ninety percent across three straight epochs flags the pair and zeroes their shared credit. Fifty clones need fifty distinct tenths, so fifty separate reading loads: forty minutes of checking apiece, five hours of real reading per epoch, roughly $180 a day at $15 an hour. A raven calls once and the forest answers; fifty willow cuttings share one pulse and one root.
